source_scope: KAIMAN/KERAKAM WT1.3 sheets 40-47, physical PDF pages 80-87
key_findings: WT1.3 repeated brick-faced wall stack remains 120 + 10 + 380 + 15 = 525 mm.
WT1.3 window sections print storey 3000 mm, sill 940 mm and clear opening 1630 mm.

Flat-slab window-head assembly prints 120 + 10 + 120 + 140 + 120 + 15 mm horizontally; KERAKAM x2 height 138 mm, 10 mm interlayer and PKB lintel height 65 mm are retained as separate endpoint-bound dimensions.
Overall section sheets 40/42/44/46 print an upper insulation segment of 80 mm while paired enlarged-node sheets 41/43/45/47 print 150 mm. v2.5 does not normalize this mismatch.
Enlarged node 1 uses a 230 mm inner structural zone, while enlarged node 3 prints 290 mm. These remain separate node-class geometries.
Balcony sections retain printed projecting slab depth 160 mm, wall-side support/slab depth 250 mm and 30 mm lower mounting-foam layer.
Flat-slab sections retain 180 mm slab depth and 30 mm lower layer.
safety: Only visually printed values with explicit semantic endpoints were bound.
Cross-sheet mismatches are preserved as blockers, not averaged or silently corrected.
Values remain source technical solutions, not current normative requirements.
Project structural sizing and any unbound secondary details remain fail-closed.
